text: Dull ache near my right temple for the last three days and it hurts a bit to chew my food. No fever, no vomiting, just a little tired.

arms.why: giant cell arteritis — sight-threatening, needs same-day steroids

text: Cough and a temperature of 100.4 that started yesterday. Feeding a bit less than usual and sleeping more.

arms.why: any fever under 3 months is a sepsis workup

text: I have noticed blood in my urine for two days. There is no pain at all when I pass it and no burning.

arms.why: painless haematuria over 50 is urological cancer until excluded

text: Limping on the right leg since this morning and does not want to put weight on it. No fall and no injury that anyone saw.

arms.why: atraumatic limp in a child is septic hip until excluded

text: Pain in the shin at night that is bad enough to wake me from sleep. It has been going on for about five weeks.

arms.why: night bone pain in a child is not growing pains
night pain is an alarm feature at any age

text: Bad headache that built up over a day, my vision has gone a bit blurred and my hands and face look puffy.

arms.why: still needs looking at, but not the same emergency

text: Sore throat and a fever since last night, generally miserable and off food.
Slipped in the bathroom and hit the side of my head on the basin. Feel alright now, just a mild headache and a bit slow.

arms.why: elderly head injury — subdural risk even with a lucid interval
observe at home with safety-net advice

text: My voice has been hoarse for about five weeks now. It does not hurt, it just has not come back.

arms.why: persistent hoarseness over 50 — laryngeal cancer pathway

text: There is a lump in my neck. It does not hurt, I noticed it about three weeks ago and it seems slightly bigger now.

arms.why: painless growing neck node in an older adult

text: Sudden pain and swelling on one side of the scrotum that started about two hours ago, and I feel sick with it.

arms.why: CONTROL — torsion is an emergency at any age

text: Pain that started around my belly button yesterday and has moved down to the lower right side. Feeling sick and off food.
My back has hurt since I lifted a heavy bag two days ago. No numbness, no problem passing urine.

arms.why: low-trauma vertebral fracture in an older woman

text: Wheezing and a lot of coughing at night, and it gets much worse after running about.
I have been very tired and I have lost about six kilos over two months without trying to.

arms.why: unintentional weight loss in an older adult
CONTROL — weight loss is an alarm at any age

text: Watery motions about six times today, not keeping much down, and not drinking very much either.
